mapper.insert: insert into common_stsctrl (msg_id, biz_prty, send_time, interval_second, confirm_timeout, notify_timeout, presume_status, lock_sts, env_info, gmt_create ) values (#{msgId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{bizPrty,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{sendTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{intervalSecond,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{confirmTimeout,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{notifyTimeout,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{presumeStatus,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{lockSts,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{envInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(3) )

select c.msg_id, c.biz_prty, c.send_time, c.interval_second, c.confirm_timeout, c.notify_timeout, c.presume_status, c.lock_sts, c.env_info,c.gmt_create from common_stsctrl c left join settlement_prod p on p.msg_id = c.msg_id
where c.lock_sts = '2' and (p.msg_tp = 'dcep.262.010.01') and p.msg_id = '20251030011126212100001100562860'
and (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{sysTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})-UNIX_TIMESTAMP(c.send_time) > c.interval_second)
and c.env_info = #{envInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (c.env_info = #{envInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or c.env_info is null)
order by c.send_time asc limit 100

select msg_id, biz_prty, send_time, interval_second, confirm_timeout, notify_timeout, presume_status, lock_sts, env_info, gmt_create from common_stsctrl where lock_sts = '1' and (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(#{sysTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})-UNIX_TIMESTAMP(send_time) >= 80)
and env_info = #{envInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (env_info = #{envInfo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or env_info is null)
order by send_time limit 100
